title: Add deterministic core unit tests
description:
Create focused deterministic unit tests for the three core modules: AudioFormat, RingBuffer, and OutputPathPolicy. Each test file exercises the public API of its corresponding module with no PipeWire dependency, no filesystem side-effects beyond temp directories, and no timing-sensitive assertions.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/core/AudioFormat.hpp and src/core/AudioFormat.cpp for AudioFormat/SampleFormat/ConversionProvenance types and helpers.
- src/audio/AudioRingBuffer.hpp and src/audio/AudioRingBuffer.cpp for ring buffer capacity, read/write/overflow semantics, and thread-safety contracts.
- src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp and src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp for naming-template expansion, directory creation policy, and collision handling.
- CMakeLists.txt for the existing test target structure and test framework (expect Google Test or Catch2).

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

test_audio_format.cpp: Test format enum round-trips, sample-rate/bit-depth/channel accessors, native-vs-converted classification, format string rendering, and invalid-input edge cases.

test_ring_buffer.cpp: Test single-threaded write-read cycles, capacity boundary, overwrite/overflow policy, partial reads, empty-buffer reads, and power-of-two size enforcement.

test_output_path_policy.cpp: Test naming-template variable expansion (date, time, source name, sequence number), directory path assembly, filename collision avoidance (numeric suffix), and rejection of invalid template variables.
acceptance_criteria: tests/core/test_audio_format.cpp exists and compiles as part of the test target
tests/core/test_ring_buffer.cpp exists and compiles as part of the test target
tests/core/test_output_path_policy.cpp exists and compiles as part of the test target
Each test file contains at least 5 distinct test cases exercising the described scenarios
No test depends on PipeWire, network, or wall-clock timing
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: choose edge-case values for boundary tests
use temporary directories for output path tests
forbidden: add PipeWire or audio device dependencies to tests
